column1: # policy group, build A (note 0009 D7.1, B09). Builder A, 2026-11-20.
# Sources: EasyMesh through the usp-spec MCP server (doc easymesh): §3.1.2 Conventions (bit/byte order per [2] = IEEE
#   1905.1, multi-octet integers big-endian unless otherwise stated; reserved objects set to zero by the sender,
#   ignored by the recipient; the sender shall not use a reserved code value), §17.2.11 Table 33, §17.2.12 Table 34,
#   §17.2.92 Table 114, §17.2.93 Table 115 (+ §17.1.61, §20.2.1, §20.2.4 searched for presence rules: none found).
#   TLV codes from the tables match em-types codes.rs:270-271 (0x89, 0x8a), 314-315 (0xb5, 0xb6), 318-319 (0xb9,
#   Upstream (pinned ba4180b, read from an extracted copy): em_policy_cfg.cpp:44-145 (0x8a sender; returns 0 at :66-75
#   and :100-103, TLV still added at :546-556), :147-271 (0x89 sender, spec layout, Steering_Policy cast from the DM
#   enum so 0x03 can be sent), :304-332 (0xc4: rprt_flag b7, reserved 0, htonl rate; 0 octets when no policy, added
#   at :604-616), :336-349 + :618-646 (0xd0: one TLV per BSSID, 7 octets, null BSSID skipped), :351-392 + :648-669
#   (0xdb: counts capped at 16, 20 zero octets, not sent when both lists are empty), :745-894 (receiver);
#   em.cpp:2070-2107 (0xb6: Num_SSID = DM network SSID count, len + strlen bytes + htons VLAN), :2109-2138 (0xb5:
#   htons VLAN, PCP & 7 in b7-5, reserved 0; 0 octets when no policy, added at em_policy_cfg.cpp:561-570);
#   em_configuration.cpp:3758-3765 (M2: 0xb5 always 3 zero octets; 0xb6 as above); em_base.h:1697-1701, 1761-1773,
#   2108-2158, 960-965 (packed structs). No production sender or receiver for 0xb9, 0xba, 0xdc.
#   on every row except UNSURE 174 and 180, answered by note 0009 D3 (174: any VLAN carried raw, VLAN 0 included;
#   180: Num_SSID = list length). No UPSTREAM row: note 0008 D6 (host order -> little-endian) applies to no field here.
#   Note 0009 D2 (raw reserved values, zero counts), D4 (lenient empty values of 0x8a, 0xb5, 0xc4), D5 (802.11
#   elements raw), D8; A8 checked: no table in this group has a "shall" rule that governs field presence (0x89
#   "Not included if previous field is set to zero" is sized by the count itself), and no table says "one or more",
#   so every zero count here is a spec case.
# Byte order of every multi-octet integer (hex = tlvValue only); all big-endian:
#   0xb9 Rule Id (4): §3.1.2; audit 216 SPEC (upstream struct is host-order but nothing sends it; not little-endian).
#   0xdc QMID (2): §3.1.2; audit 272 SPEC (no upstream sender; not little-endian).
#   Every other field is a 1-octet integer, a 6-octet MAC, a bit-field octet or raw octets.
#   0x89: Num_Local(1), Num_Local x STA_MAC(6), Num_BTM(1), Num_BTM x STA_MAC(6), Num_Radio(1), Num_Radio x { RUID(6),
#         Steering_Policy(1; 0x03-0xff reserved, raw), Utilization_Threshold(1), RCPI_Threshold(1; 221-255 raw) }.
#   0x8a: Interval(1), Num_Radio(1), Num_Radio x { RUID(6), STA_RCPI_Threshold(1; 221-255 raw), STA_RCPI_Hysteresis
#         (1; the spec table labels this row "STA_RCPI_Threshold" a second time, description "Hysteresis Margin
#         Override"), AP_Utilization_Threshold(1), octet {STA_Traffic_Stats b7, STA_Link_Metrics b6, STA_Status b5,
#   0xb5: VLAN(2), octet {PCP b7-5, Reserved b4-0}. Exactly 3.
#   0xb6: Num_SSID(1), Num_SSID x { SSID Length(1), SSID(SSID Length; raw, 0-255), VLAN(2; reserved values raw) }.
#   0xc4: octet {Report b7, Reserved b6-0}, Maximum Reporting Rate(4). Exactly 5.
#   0xd0: BSSID(6), octet {Profile-1 bSTA Disallowed b7, Profile-2 bSTA Disallowed b6, Reserved b5-0}. Exactly 7.
#   0xb9: Rule Id(4), octet {Add-Remove b7, Reserved b6-0}, Precedence(1; 0xff reserved, raw), Output(1; 0x0a-0xff
#         reserved, raw), octet {Always Match b7, Reserved b6-0}. Exactly 8.
#   0xba: 64 x PCP(1; 0x08-0xff reserved, raw), DSCP 0x00..0x3f in increasing order. Exactly 64.
#   0xdb: Num_MSCS(1), Num_MSCS x MAC(6), Num_SCS(1), Num_SCS x MAC(6), Reserved(20 octets). No cap of 16 (audit 271).
#   0xdc: QMID(2), BSSID(6), Client MAC(6), Descriptor Element (the rest of the value, raw octets; D5).
#   (1) Items are written in the listed order, each at its own position, except the bit-group items of rule (3).
#   (2) Widths: 6-octet MACs (12 hex digits): 0x89 lK_mac, bK_mac, rK_ruid; 0x8a rK_ruid; 0xd0 bssid; 0xdb mK_mac,
#       sK_mac; 0xdc bssid, client_mac. 2 octets big-endian: 0xb5 vlan, 0xb6 sK_vlan, 0xdc qmid. 4 octets
#       big-endian: 0xc4 rate, 0xb9 rule_id. Every other integer item is 1 octet (counts locals, btms, radios,
#       ssids, mscs, scs; lengths sK_len; interval, rK_policy, rK_util, rK_rcpi, rK_hyst, precedence, output, and
#       0xba pK = the PCP for DSCP value K). Values are decimal or 0x-hex.
#   (3) Bit-field octets: each group is ONE octet, written at the position of the group's first listed item; flag
#       values are 0/1, unshifted; pcp is the 3-bit value (0-7), unshifted, placed in b7-5; a reserved mask is
#       given in octet position and ORed in (absent = 0). Groups: 0x8a {rK_traffic b7, rK_link b6, rK_status b5,
#       rK_reserved b4-0}; 0xb5 {pcp b7-5, reserved b4-0}; 0xc4 {report b7, reserved b6-0}; 0xd0 {p1 b7, p2 b6,
#       reserved b5-0}; 0xb9 two separate octets {add b7, add_reserved b6-0} and {always b7, always_reserved b6-0}.
#       A case that sets a reserved mask: the decoder ignores it, the encoder writes zero (canonical bytes = the
#       *-clear sibling, or the same fields with the mask 0).
#   (4) Count and length items (locals, btms, radios, ssids, sK_len, mscs, scs) are written as given; only the entries
#       listed follow (a count or length above the listed data = overstated). Entry names: 0x89 lK_mac, bK_mac,
#       rK_*; 0x8a rK_*; 0xb6 sK_len, sK_ssid, sK_vlan; 0xdb mK_mac, sK_mac.
#   (5) Byte-string items are hex: raw octets written exactly as given, with NO length octet in front: 0xb6 sK_ssid
#       (its length is the separate sK_len item), 0xdb reserved (the 20 reserved octets, a whole-octet item; a
#       nonzero value is ignored on decode, the encoder writes 20 zero octets), 0xdc descriptor (hex: alone = no
#   (6) An item given as hex: where it normally takes a MAC or integer is a cut field: exactly those raw octets are
#       written. An item not listed is absent from the bytes.
#   (7) trailing=hex: raw octets appended after the listed fields.
#   (8) kind=lenient;decoded=absent (0x8a, 0xb5, 0xc4 empty-upstream): decode_value_lenient returns Ok(None); the
#       strict decoder rejects the same (empty) value with Truncated. No separate strict "empty" row for these TLVs.
# Choices (for the coordinator): (a) every cut field, partial entry or overstated count/length is error=Truncated (as
#   B01-B08); extra octets after a complete layout are TrailingBytes (0xb5 4 octets, 0xc4 6, 0xd0 8 incl.
#   two-entries-one-tlv, 0xb9 9, 0xba 65, 0xdb after the 20 reserved octets). Fixed-length tables with a short value
#   (0xb9 7 octets, 0xba 63) are Truncated, not InvalidLength. (b) 0xdc descriptor is the raw rest of the value, so
#   there is no trailing case; empty-descriptor and one-octet-descriptor are kind=spec (consistent with D5 raw
#   pass-through and 0xa0 empty payload), although the table says the field is "One of" three elements. The
#   alternative is invalid/Truncated for an empty descriptor. (c) 0xb5 VLAN 0 (vlan-zero-upstream-m2, the bytes
#   em_configuration.cpp:3760-3761 sends) and 0xffff are kind=spec (D3 line 174). (d) 0xb6 reserved VLANs (0x0000
#   that upstream sends for untagged SSIDs, 0x0002, 0x0fff, 0xffff), SSID length 0, 32, 33, and a trailing NUL in the
#   SSID are kind=spec (D2 raw; D4 NUL example). six-ssids pins audit 177 (upstream skips more than 5). (e) 0x89
#   Steering_Policy 0x03 (upstream can send it, audit 55) and 0xff, RCPI 221/255 are raw kind=spec; seventeen-locals,
#   seventeen-btms and five-radios pin the upstream caps 16/4 (audit 53/54). (f) 0x8a five-radios pins the cap 4
#   (audit 58); RCPI 221/255 raw. (g) 0xc4 rate-above-65535 pins audit 194 (no truncation to u16). (h) 0xd0
#   zero-bssid is kind=spec (upstream only declines to send it). (i) 0xdb zero-both is kind=spec although upstream
#   never sends it (:665-671); seventeen-mscs pins the cap 16 (audit 271); reserved-19-octets is Truncated.
#   (j) 0xdc qmid 0 is kind=spec (§20.2.4: QMID "reserved" in an agent-originated notification; raw).
